speaker: caller
text: Good afternoon, this is Officer Lim from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh, hello. What is this about?

speaker: caller
text: Our records show your passport details were used to register a SIM card in Shanghai last month.

speaker: receiver
text: Shanghai? I have never been to Shanghai.

speaker: caller
text: That number was used in a money laundering case, so the Chinese authorities have issued a notice under your name.

speaker: receiver
text: That can't be right. What should I do?

speaker: caller
text: I will transfer you now to Inspector Zhang from the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. Please stay on the line.

speaker: caller
text: This is Inspector Zhang. If you do not cooperate today, a warrant will be issued and you can be arrested at the airport.

speaker: receiver
text: Please, I didn't do anything wrong.

speaker: caller
text: To clear your name, you must move all your savings into a supervision account so we can check the money is clean.

speaker: receiver
text: All of it? How do I do that?

speaker: caller
text: Go to the bank now and transfer it. Do not tell the bank staff or your family, this is a confidential investigation.

speaker: receiver
text: I need to think about this first.
